brief.name: Skyhook Sprint
brief.pitch: Swing a grapple between floating islands and flip switches in the right order to build a bridge, one thumb at a time.
mechanics: Flip switches in the correct order to build a bridge
Ghost replays of your best run
brief.art_style: Crisp flat vector sky with bold outlines
facts: Core control is hold to swing and release to jump
Players build bridges by flipping switches in the right order
Ghost replays show your best run
The art style is crisp flat vector sky with bold outlines
The palette is sky #1E6FD9, cloud #EAF4FF, sun #FFC93C, and ink #101820
The target audience is commuters who play with one hand
brief.launch_goal: Reach commuters who play with one hand by delivering a satisfying one-thumb puzzler with 80 levels and ghost replays at launch.

concepts.audience_note: Riders on trains and buses who want to turn travel time into a quick burst of fun. They are usually standing or holding a strap, so one-hand play suits their day.
concepts.angle: Position the game as the thing that makes a commute feel like a sprint rather than dead time.
concepts.hook_line: Turn your commute into a sky sprint.

meta.headline: Turn your commute into a sky sprint
meta.text: Hold to swing, release to jump. Flip switches in order to build bridges between floating islands. Play with one thumb.
